Sentence (English): Our old (original to the house, 20 years old) dishwasher finally died so I had the leverage to get a new one (hubby prefers hand washing).
Comments (English): [ I'm impressed! ] || ---------------- || Our old (original to the house, 20 years old) dishwasher finally died so I had the leverage to get a new one (hubby prefers hand washing). I'd done my research, and had a small wait until black Friday deals came out and this went on sale. It does NOT disappoint! The lights inside are nice, easy to see what's inside. The middle rack is easy to adjust up or down, depending on where additional room is needed. Plenty of clearance! The 3rd rack is something I've wanted a long time. Just deep enough to hold utensils, without taking up too much room.Performance has been great! We typically use the 1 hour cycle, and regular dishes come out sparkly clean, even if we don't run it nightly. I keep testing it with dirtier and dirtier dishes, and it works like a champ.For really baked on casserole dishes, I use the more powerful, longer running cycle. Pots and pans so far have come out nice and clean. A pan of maccaroni and cheese came out spotless, a pan of baked on pumpkin came out with a bit of residue (will try to leave pics), was easy to finish cleaning by hand. As for noise, the only thing we hear is the water draining out, even standing right next to it! My husband, who scorns dishwashers, has started using this one. THAT is how good it is. I can't speak to reliability over time, but so far I'm delighted with our choice.

Sentence (English): I have a GE profile dishwasher that is approximately 14 months old.
Comments (English): [ Fire hazard/ ruined my cabinet ] || ---------------- || I have a GE profile dishwasher that is approximately 14 months old. It has been producing excessive heat,particularly on the left side of the appliance, even without the heat drying function enabled. The heat is soexcessive that it has caused warping/bubbling, and deformities of the wood cabinetry directly adjacent to the dishwasher. Multiple dishwashers have been in this spot previous to this one and have never caused this type of damage. The area is hot to the touch while the dishwasher is running.As a full-time professional fireman, I am concerned that this creates a potential for a fire hazard. GE representatives could not have been less concerned. They told me to pay for a service appointment to diagnose the issue. No extenuating circumstances were issued due to me being 2 months outside of warranty, and no questions or curiosity were portrayed with regards to safety issue an overheating dishwasher would warrant. I'm shocked something like this doesn't raise red flags within their customer service when it could potentially injure or kill someone, regardless of when the warranty expired. I have filed a report with the Consumer Product Safety Commission and am hoping this may produce a recall.

Not sure what to do at this point. Installation was not I expected. The guy looked mad, did not want to have any conversation and any questions we asked, we were told to contact Costco. Costco needs to look into improving its delivery and installation services.

Sentence (English): I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. It can also be controlled with the app. The app shows more cleaning functions, so I'm going to use them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? A truly great value for money item! I highly recommend this to those who find a large dishwasher too burdensome and those who want a dishwasher with good performance at a reasonable price. -- If this review was helpful, please click the Helpful button below >_<--

Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. It can also be controlled with the app. The app shows more cleaning functions, so I'm going to use them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? A truly great value for money item! I highly recommend this to those who find a large dishwasher too burdensome and those who want a dishwasher with good performance at a reasonable price. -- If this review was helpful, please click the Helpful button below >_<--

Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. It can also be controlled with the app. The app shows more cleaning functions, so I'm going to use them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? A truly great value for money item! Sentence (English): Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician.
Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. It can also be controlled with the app. The app shows more cleaning functions, so I'm going to use them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? A truly great value for money item! I highly recommend this to those who find a large dishwasher too burdensome and those who want a dishwasher with good performance at a reasonable price. -- If this review was helpful, please click the Helpful button below >_<--

Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat dinner at home, but there are so many dishes to wash and it's so annoying that I really wanted a dishwasher. In fact, in Korea, the most popular dishwasher is Sam-daeng or El-daeng, but I was a little worried because it was the first time I heard of this brand on the media. But it was really a needless worry. It's a perfect number one item for aunts. The design is neat and goes well with the modern interior. I really like the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the technician first installed it, I thought it was too big? But it's actually prettier because it's bigger. It feels like the kitchen interior is complete with just this one thing. I didn't want to make a mess, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink, but it's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you have to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water supply hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won.) If you just attach the drain hose part to the sink and hide it, it's perfect! Installation was done in 30 minutes, friendly technician. On the morning of the day of installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from the beginning to the end and explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, and it was completely smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is really spacious, so you can fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung, so you can safely put spoons and chopsticks in. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it's very useful. I only use the standard mode, and it washes it very cleanly. The automatic door opening function & app controllable This is my favorite function! The door automatically opens when the cleaning is done. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work and leave, and the door automatically opens when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying or mold. It can also be controlled with the app. The app shows more cleaning functions, so I'm going to use them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. I think it is really one of the most satisfying functions in a home. And it can be linked to an app, so it provides convenient usability. Sentence (English): We purchased the GE Cafe 2 drawer dishwasher for our new home, aiming for the convenience of running smaller loads while matching our other appliances.
Comments (English): [ Unreliable dishwasher, poor customer service ] || ---------------- || We purchased the GE Cafe 2 drawer dishwasher for our new home, aiming for the convenience of running smaller loads while matching our other appliances.However, we have had nothing but issues with this dishwasher since we got it and GE Customer Care has been extremely difficult to deal with and won't honor what we agreed to over the phone with them (more on that later). The initial installation was flawed, causing the unit to move slightly when opening the drawers. Additionally, the top drawer rubbed against a screw holding the top bracket, resulting in scratches. After a service visit, the unit was secured properly and no longer moved.A couple of weeks later, the top drawer stopped drying the dishes, leaving water at the bottom and wet dishes after each cycle no matter how long we left the drying fan run. Another service visit diagnosed the issue, and it was determined that some parts, including one of the main boards, needed replacement on this brand-new dishwasher. It would take several weeks to get the parts in. In the meantime, the bottom drawer started exhibiting the same behavior. We called back and they said they would try to resolve both drawers when they came out.So maybe a month later, several parts were replaced during that visit, and the problem seemed resolved temporarily. Fast forward maybe 3 weeks and the top drawer stops drying again. At this point, we basically hate this dishwasher and want nothing to do with it. Between the horrible quality and annoying things about the dishdrawer style, we just want to exchange it for a standard swing-down door dishwasher. We know there is supposed to be a 30 day return limit, but the unit hasn't even been working correctly for a total of 30 days, and it takes longer than that for them to get parts to try to fix it. If we knew it would just keep breaking, we would have asked to return it right away. We called GE Customer Care, and after about an hour with the rep, he agreed to exchange it for the different GE Cafe model we wanted, which costs a lot more, and we'd pay the difference. We got the quote, and he said he'd needed to check to see if the custom color handle we bought would fit the new dishwasher or would we need to purchase that separately. We called back maybe an hour later to finalize everything, but we got a different rep. This time they said that the exchange has been declined. They would only send out another repair crew to try to fix it. If we wanted a different dishwasher, we'd just have to pay full price to buy it. If they deem this unit unrepairable, they will replace it with a new one of the same type. So now we are basically stuck with a horrible dishwasher, poor customer service, and regret furnishing our new home with all GE Cafe appliances. If they can fix it again, we'll likely try to sell it and purchase a different brand altogether. Stay away from GE Cafe and especially the dishdrawer style dishwasher. Nothing but stress and headaches from the appliance and the brand.

Sentence (English): After having lived with and worn out multiple basic dishwashers, we decided to upgrade to a higher end machine.
Comments (English): [ Well worth it ] || ---------------- || After having lived with and worn out multiple basic dishwashers, we decided to upgrade to a higher end machine. Here's the difference: this dishwasher actually cleans your dishes. All we do is scrape off the chunks and put them in the machine and they come out clean. I even tested the limits of this by putting in bakeware that we used to have to soak before hand washing. I put the pan in the bottom rack and chose the heavy cycle and identified the location of the pan and IT CAME OUT CLEAN! Everything else we've owned were just glorified rinsers. This actually washes our dishes. The Crystal Dry mode works as advertised: your platics actually come out dry so you don't have to manually dry them before putting them into your cabinets. It is QUIET. We used to wait to run our dishwasher as we went to bed so we didn't have to listen to it. Now, we can start it immediately after dinner and you can only tell it is running by the light on the machine or by checking the app. The third rack for silverware and small prep and serving utensils is AMAZING. This frees up space in your two main racks, helping fit more items. It is a little more work to load the silverware so precisely (I sort them by type), but you gain that back when you put the silverware away as they are already sorted for your drawer. If you've suffered through entry-level dishwashers, thinking it isn't worth it to spend the money for a better machine, this one has proven to me that it is worth it.

Sentence (English): I bought Model Number KDTM404KPS about 3-4 weeks ago.
Comments (English): [ I'm sorry I bought this model ] || ---------------- || I bought Model Number KDTM404KPS about 3-4 weeks ago. I never had a dishwasher with 3 racks before. But I'm so sorry I got it. I'm also sorry that I have to share this information, but I want to give an honest review. In the bottom rack, you can't even place a butcher knife or a spatula to stand up in the utensil basket because the water propeller just above it will hit it. You can't even place large pans sideways in the bottom rack or it will also interfere with the water propeller. Further, no instructions were in the manual that explained what the different colors indicated for wash, dry, and complete. Trying to google the question brought no results. Finally, I called the salesman and we pretty much arrived at what each color meant. Also, while the top (3rd) rack is great for glasses and cups, the insert on which you are to lay spatulas and long utensils is very poor. They don't really lay well in the designated slots. Also, when the dishwasher is all through, while the bottom and middle rack dishes are dry, the top (3rd) rack isn't dry. I'm pretty much stuck with this and I'll handle these dissatisfactions. But next time, I will definitely go with the older style dishwasher with only 2 racks because you can load more, and there's no problems with large pans or butcher knives interfering with the water propeller.

Sentence (English): I recently purchased my first Bosch 300 dishwasher after reading reviews for multiple other brands.
Comments (English): [ Top Reviews Seem Justified ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased my first Bosch 300 dishwasher after reading reviews for multiple other brands. This model came out on top in my price range. It isn't inexpensive but apparently is worth the greater cost. I like the clean, solid look both inside and out. One feature advertised is the lack of an exposed element on the bottom, which others have to speed drying but which also melts anything plastic that might be dislodged from the racks. Drying in this unit, is apparently achieved by added heat in the stainless steel interior walls. Multiple reviews claim soaking dishes after a wash, however. I believe that the disparity comes from timing. If dishes are removed immediately after the cycle has ended, they will be very wet. But allow them to sit and the heated interior will remove that water. Another feature advertised, is the sound level. I really am impressed. I wasnt sure it was filling initially, despite the timer counting down. Eventually, the wash began and washing could be heard, if you're in the room and little else is making any sound. Water going down the drain was a little louder than my previous washer, but thats over in no time. This unit is very quiet. The top rack is a nice feature, and granted, won't fit larger items, but it takes very little space, handles many, many knives, forks and spoons, and gets them all clean. An appreciated feature is the 'standard' cutlery basket. This one can not only be completely removed, if the top one is sufficient, making room for additional or bigger items on the bottom, but it can also slide left or right, to allow a better fit. The middle rack can be lowered or raised to better fit your particular items, though many washers have this feature. This washer remembers your last or favorite cycle, which can be different, and makes starting the unit as quick and easy as possible, unless you want something different. The last comment I have is one large flaw with this unit. I'm extremely surprised by this one as it has been so signifficant and appears to have been ignored by Bosh for apparently years - serious marring of a company's responsiveness. I'm referring to its app. Yes, there's an app for this dishwasher, and it is one of the things first noted in the accompanying literature. Apparently it allows you to start your dishwasher remotely and allows other options that aren't available directly from the unit itself. I say apparently, because I have never used or even installed it. Read the complaints that have been written about this software. Horrendous for years and no sign of any improvement. I have no need to start my washer remotely and am satisfied with the current features. My advice to Bosh: Distance yourself from this app. It makes your product look very bad.

Sentence (English): About 2 years ago, we replaced our dishwasher with a new mid-range priced model from Maytag since that was what our old dishwasher was.
Comments (English): [ The finest kitchen appliance we've ever owned! ] || ---------------- || About 2 years ago, we replaced our dishwasher with a new mid-range priced model from Maytag since that was what our old dishwasher was. It was certainly an improvement over the old one but by no means perfect. But from the very beginning and continuing to get worse over time, whenever I unloaded it, there were always items I had to finish cleaning. It was only 2 years old, so still pretty much new, so replacing it was a big decision, but several weeks ago, I finally got fed up with not really having a dishwasher but instead a dish pre-washer. There are two major kitchen appliances that have to work more or less perfectly to make having them worthwhile -- the refrigerator and the dishwasher. They either work well or they are useless to have. We decided to replace it and did our research, and this unit was at the top of the list. Over the last month, not a single time did I have to rewash ANYTHING. AND because of its novel ability to actually dry the dishes almost every time, everything is pretty much dry and NOT dripping wet. From the iPhone app that controls it right up to all the thought that went into how the racks were designed and the far better top rack for utensils, there is so much more we love about this dishwasher. One of the reviews I remember reading before deciding to go with BOSCH said, "It's the finest kitchen appliance we've ever owned". And WE AGREE COMPLETELY!

Sentence (English): I purchased this item based on my research on recommendations I read online.
Comments (English): [ My first impressions. ] || ---------------- || I purchased this item based on my research on recommendations I read online. My LG started leaking from underneath and since it was 10 years old, I decided to get a new one. It would cost me close to 300$ in CA to pay an appliance repair service anyway. Sound level was not my main concern but this model is definitely more quiet. I haven't used it very much as I do not have a large family; however, in the short time I have used it, I'm not happy about the amount of room inside for larger dishes and pans. They must have sacrificed internal capacity for more sound insulation IMO. I do not like the rack layout very much at all. Perhaps I will get used to it, but I just can't fit near as many dishes in it as I could in my LG. The first few times I used it the soap packets did not dissolve completely (yes I used the exact recommended brand). Apparently, the dispenser tray must be thoroughly dry and you must put the pack in a certain way. It is far too soon to comment on reliability. I also noticed that even after using the crystal dry setting, there is water trapped in flat areas in the upper and middle rack (handles? ) that do not drain. Because of this, it is best to empty the clean dishes from the bottom up or you will need to dry them again by hand.

Sentence (English): MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Greige, MNDW-110G, Customer Installation Review: My wrists hurt after work, and washing dishes was a burden, so I brought in a dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for those who are renting a house! ] || ---------------- || MINIX Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Greige, MNDW-110G, Customer Installation Review: My wrists hurt after work, and washing dishes was a burden, so I brought in a dishwasher! And... I never thought a small appliance could be this satisfying. I had previously used a MINIX dryer and was satisfied, so I chose a MINIX dishwasher as well. First of all, the design is clean and luxurious. The "greige" color blends well with my kitchen and adds a sophisticated touch. I live alone, so a dishwasher that was too large was a burden. This one fits comfortably in the small kitchen of my 70-square-foot (21-pyeong) apartment. It's designed for 3 people, so it's the perfect size for a one- or two-person household. Installation was easy. It's not a direct water connection, but a manual water supply means you fill the water tank manually. The advantage is that it's easy to use, even without an installer. I was initially worried about having to fill it manually, but it only takes about 5 liters to clean the dishwasher, so it wasn't a big deal. Using the provided water container, you can simply pour the water in about three times. I had access to the water line, so I poured the water myself. A beeping sound notifies you when the water is full. I recommend this for those who find drilling holes difficult in a rented house! I'm also very satisfied with the performance. The key to a dishwasher is its cleaning power, and the Minix PRO cleans even greasy dishes and pots thoroughly. Glassware, in particular, is squeaky clean after washing, and I'm very satisfied with the lack of water stains. There are various modes, including normal and intensive wash, so you can choose the right one for your needs. I found that the normal wash was sufficient for most situations. The reason I chose the Minix dishwasher was its auto-open and hot air drying functions. I was very pleased that it automatically cleans the dishes after each wash, so I could go about my daily routine without having to open the door. It's convenient to take out the dishes right after washing. The biggest advantage of using a dishwasher is the time savings. It's much more convenient than washing dishes by hand, and its powerful cleaning power makes it easier to keep the dishes tidier. However, since it's only for 3 people, it's disappointing that large pots or frying pans won't fit. Also, Tetris is harder than I thought, so I think I'll have to use it a bit more to know for sure. I know that Minix has a dedicated detergent, but it arrived without it, so I used the Tamsa dishwasher detergent I had on hand from Coupang, but it left more water marks than I expected. (Based on reviews of Tamsa detergent, it seems like it's the same for all machines.) I'll purchase and use the Minix detergent in addition and leave an additional review. Overall, the Minix dishwasher offers excellent value for money. Compared to large dishwashers, it's reasonably priced and offers excellent space utilization. I highly recommend this product to people who live alone or with small households. I guess that's why they call it "the dishwasher aunt." Highly recommended for those renting! This is an honest review written after purchasing it with my own money. If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button below.
Comments (Original): [ 전세집 사시는 분들에게 강추! ] || ---------------- || 미닉스 미니 식기세척기 PRO 3인용, 그레이지, MNDW-110G, 고객직접설치 구매후기  일하고오면 손목이 아픈데 설거지까지 하려니 손목이 부담이 되어 식세기이모님을 들였어요! 그리고...소형 가전이 이렇게 만족스러울 줄 몰랐습니다. 기존에 미닉스 제품의 건조기를 사용해보고 만족스러웠던터라 식기세척기도 미닉스로 선택했습니다  우선 디자인이 깔끔하고 고급스럽습니다. ‘그레이지’ 컬러가 주방에 잘 어울리며, 세련된 느낌을 더해줍니다.  1인가구인데 너무 큰 식세기는 부담이었거든요 21평 구축 아파트의 작은 주방에도 무리 없이 배치할 수 있습니다. 3인용이라는 점에서 1~2인 가구에 딱 맞는 크기같아요  설치는 어렵지 않았습니다. 직수 연결이 아닌 수동 급수 방식이라 물통에 물을 채워 넣는 방식입니다. 설치 기사 없이도 쉽게 사용할 수 있는 점이 장점입니다. 처음에는 직접 물을 채우는 게 번거로울까 걱정했지만, 5리터 정도만 채우면 세척이 가능해 크게 부담스럽지 않았습니다. 제공해주신 물통을 이용할경우 약 3회정도에 걸쳐 부어주면 끝입니다. 저는 수도 선이 닿아서 직접 물을 부어줬어요 물이 가득차면 삐삐 소리로 안내가 됩니다 전세집이라서 타공이 어려운분들에게 추천 !  성능 면에서도 만족스럽습니다. 식기세척기의 핵심은 세척력인데, 미닉스 PRO는 기름기가 많은 식기나 냄비도 깔끔하게 세척됩니다. 특히 유리컵은 세척 후 뽀득뽀득한 느낌이 들 정도로 깨끗하고, 물얼룩이 남지 않아 만족스럽습니다. 일반 세척, 강력 세척등 다양한 모드가 있어 상황에 맞게 사용할 수 있습니다. 저는 대부분 일반 세척으로 사용해도 충분히 깨끗하게 닦이더군요.  무엇보다 미닉스 식기세척기를 사용한 이유는 자동문열림 + 열풍건조 기능때문이었는데요 세척 후에도 알아서 관리가 되니 따로 문열어줄필요 없이 일상 생활을 해도 된다는게 아주 만족스러웠어요 세척 후 바로 식기를 꺼내 사용하기 편리합니다. 무엇보다 식기세척기를 사용하면서 느낀 가장 큰 장점은 시간 절약입니다. 손으로 설거지를 할 때보다 훨씬 편리하고, 세척력이 좋아서 식기 관리도 더 깔끔하게 됩니다. 다만 사이즈가 3인용이다보니 큰 냄비나 후라이팬은 들어가지 않아 아쉽네요 ㅠㅠ 그리고 생각보다 테트리스하는게 어려워서 조금 더 사용해봐야 알것같아요  미닉스같은 경우에는 전용세제가 따로 있다고 알고 있는데 세제 없이 와서 급한대로 제가 보유하고 있던 쿠팡의 탐사 식기세척기 세제를 이용했는데 생각보다 물자국이 조금 남더라고요 (탐사 세제 후기 보니까 모든 기기에서 그런가봐요..) 미닉스 전용 세제도 추가로 구매하여 사용해보고 추가 후기 남기겠습니다  전체적으로 미닉스 식기세척기는 가격 대비 성능이 훌륭합니다. 대형 식기세척기와 비교하면 가격이 합리적이고, 공간 활용도 면에서 탁월합니다. 혼자 사는 분들이나 소형 가구에 강력 추천하고 싶은 제품입니다.  이래서 식세기 이모님이라고 부르나봐요...★ 전세집 사시는분들에게 강추!  내돈내산으로 체험하고 솔직하게 작성한 리뷰입니다 ❤️제 리뷰가 도움이 되셨다면 하단의 도움이돼요 버튼을 눌러주세요❤️

Sentence (English): I had been lurking for a while, but when the lowest price popped up, I managed to buy it cheaply with a card discount!
Comments (English): I had been lurking for a while, but when the lowest price popped up, I managed to buy it cheaply with a card discount! I wanted white, but beige was cheaper, so I bought that. It matches our kitchen well and seems like a better choice! ^^ The only downside is that the Samsung installer doesn't work night shifts on weekdays. Since we are a dual-income couple, we had to wait until the weekend for the installation. They installed it quickly, checked that it was working, and gave us a good explanation before leaving! I was a bit surprised by how big it was, bigger than I expected! I wanted to place it to the side to make it easier to put dishes in, but the width wasn't right, so I had it installed facing forward. It looks better that way, but it is definitely a little inconvenient when putting dishes in. I chose the countertop model because I thought the built-in one would be too much work. It's great that I don't have to bend over! It's good for putting dishes in or organizing. We are a family of three including a child, and since I think it would be easier for me to handle large pots and dishes, the 6-place setting is more than enough for me. I'm using liquid detergent purchased from Coupang. Perhaps thanks to the automatic door opening, it cleans well without streaks or water stains, even without rinse aid! The sound is a bit similar to a washing machine, but it isn't very loud. Also, since I trust doing the washing myself more than a dishwasher, I can't put in a lot of dishes. Instead, I frequently run the cycle for items that require a lot of handling, like cutlery, frozen rice containers that aren't too dirty, side dish containers, and children's plates. This is really convenient! If you put in a lot of dishes, it's difficult to stack them properly unless they are all the same size, so I run small loads at a time. I think it would have been better if at least part of the front door were transparent. I'm curious about how they are being washed, and I think being able to see clearly would help me know which direction to put the next batch in. Even though the results look clean, I still feel a bit uneasy because I can't visually confirm where the water streams actually touched the dishes. For now, since it runs for an hour on the basic cycle, I try to gather as many dishes as possible before running it. I think I need to clean the strainer at the bottom frequently as well. I think it would have been better if at least part of the front door were transparent. Even though the results look clean, I still feel a bit uneasy because I can't visually confirm where the water streams actually touched the dishes. Sentence (English): Great dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ You should consider this model ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher! The third rack is more functional than most other designs and plenty of space in the other racks as well. It washes just fine and there are enough options to tailor the cycle as needed. The sound level is low and I agree with the advertise decibel rating (confirmed with a decibel meter at 3 feet). It seems like some people expect a mechanical machine to be as quiet as an iPad and that is just not realistic at all. The drying performance is good with some minor water on the bottom of some random glasses. That is quickly addressed with a dish towel (just wipe off the few and move on-it's not the end of the world). We went in with the intention to buy a Kitchenaid or a Bosch and walked out with this unit. So far it's been fantastic and has met every expectation along with saving a good chunk of capital.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher as a RGA from a dishwasher that we had bought in April.
Comments (English): [ Not a fan, very LOUD, very sensitive panel ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher as a RGA from a dishwasher that we had bought in April. The sales person suggested this. She highlighted that it was a great brand that was deeply discounted, and would be very similar to what we had purchased. We know realize it is deeply discounted because it is not a greta product. The dishwasher is LOUD. The touch panel on the front is very aggregating. A simple bump will cause the machine to start or stop (mid cycle). The cycles are VERY long. The dishes are clean, but they are still wet to the touch. If I choose the extra dry that adds an hour to the already 2-2.5 hour cycle the racks are cheaply made, they do not roll well, or load easily. Items that fit easily in our older dishwasher are a nightmare in this one. In order to lower the second rack you have to remove it completely. The third rack is so thin that very little can be placed up top. Really it's like not having a third rack because it is so useless. I would NOT recommend this machine.

Sentence (English): I had planned to buy a 12-place setting dishwasher when I moved, but once I actually moved in, there was no space for a built-in one, and no matter how hard I racked my brain, I just couldn't figure out a way.
Comments (English): [ An absolute must-have for busy parenting! ] || ---------------- || I had planned to buy a 12-place setting dishwasher when I moved, but once I actually moved in, there was no space for a built-in one, and no matter how hard I racked my brain, I just couldn't figure out a way. Washing baby bottles and sterilizing them in boiling water every day was a war every evening. Once we started introducing solid foods, the amount of dishes to wash was overwhelming, so I decided to buy a dishwasher. Reason for purchase: I bought it to try and reduce the amount of dishwashing amidst my hectic parenting life. Reason for choosing this specific product: I thought a 12-place setting built-in would fit in my 32-pyeong older apartment, but there was an unnecessary oven and kimchi refrigerator inside, so there was absolutely no space. I found it on Coupang, and since it was affordable and seemed like it would fit perfectly, I bought it right away. Pros: If you're good at Tetris, you can fit dishes from two meals and baby food containers, so you can fit a lot in. Of course, it cleans well and has excellent cleaning power. You can wash baby bottles and baby food containers without worry. At first, I washed the baby's items separately, but now I wash them together with regular dishes, and they come out clean. Standard mode takes 1 hour, and Power mode takes 1 hour and 36 minutes. I use Power mode, so it’s great for running frequently without feeling burdened. Once completed, the door opens automatically, allowing for some natural drying. Being made entirely of stainless steel, it has excellent durability and dries quickly. The design is clean, so it fits well wherever you place it. The noise level isn't high, so it's good to use even at night. Cons: You must pre-wash burnt-on food before putting it in. You also need to pre-wash stubborn grease, like chili oil, with hot water. Purchase Review: There is a reason why it is called one of the "Three Aunties" (dishwasher, robot vacuum, and dryer). It is so convenient, and my satisfaction level is very high. I don't have to be tied down doing dishes for about 30 minutes, and I am very satisfied that I can do other things during that time. Since it was Rocket Installation, they contacted me immediately after purchase to schedule the installation date and installed it right away, which is very convenient. When I run the dishwasher on Power mode, I don't need to sterilize baby bottles separately; they come out nice and hot. It is convenient for mom and baby. It’s a great dishwasher that also eases your health concerns. Sometimes, my husband and I get confused about whether the dishes are actually cleaned or not, but setting it up like in the picture makes it so much easier. I recommend making this simple setup at home and placing it on the counter! This is a review based on my own purchase. If this was helpful, please click "Helpful" (*'*)

Sentence (English): The dishwasher cleans exceptionally well and the cycle only takes 90 minutes.
Comments (English): [ Design flaws but washes well, not suitable for all ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher cleans exceptionally well and the cycle only takes 90 minutes. However, we were very disappointed to learn that the hoses and electrical cord were attached on the left side of the appliance making it impossible to set up as we had intended bc they wouldn't reach on to the faucet. In other words, we wanted to connect the dishwasher on the left of our sink but it can only be set up on the right side OR moved in front of the sink every night. Also, this dishwasher holds many fewer dishes than a typical 24”. I'd say it's best for a family of three and under. DONT buy if you want this on the left side of a double sink-it will not reach the faucet which must be connect every night.

Sentence (English): The delivery, installation and haul away process has been a nightmare.
Comments (English): [ DELIVERY PROCESS IS HORRIBLE ] || ---------------- || The delivery, installation and haul away process has been a nightmare. I was told by the sales person that the install would have to be done by a plumber and they would schedule that with delivery. The item was delivered and I was told I would be contacted on 48 hours to schedule a time for install. Why do they not schedule delivery and install at the same time? So the dishwasher sat in the middle of my kitchen for 2 days. I was told the installer would haul the old one away. He did not, the old dishwasher was then moved to my front yard where it still sits 8 days later. There has been a dishwasher in my front yard all through Christmas and I am now being told it will be there until Jan 8. I have dealt with customer service for hours and this is still not handled. Home Depot should not offer these services and charge a fairly large sum for them if they can not effectively coordinate it all without the customer being extremely inconvenienced. It is not hard to coordinate all of these things happening at the same time.

Sentence (English): Honest review of the Media automatic door opening dishwasher for 6 people!
Comments (English): [ A product I honestly recommend ] || ---------------- || Honest review of the Media automatic door opening dishwasher for 6 people! This is an honest review of the Media automatic door opening dishwasher that I bought while looking for a dishwasher. Clean design These days, the design of white appliances has been generally standardized, but sometimes when I actually see them, there are many appliances with designs that seem disappointing. However, I really liked the clean design of this product. I chose white, and it didn't break the overall white tone of my kitchen, but it gave me the feeling that it was an original object. I really liked the clean design. Perfect cleaning power No matter how pretty the design of a dishwasher is, if it doesn't wash the dishes properly, it's disappointing, but it was actually more than I expected, so I was surprised. I put in the dishes that I had kimchi fried rice and fried eggs, and they were washed perfectly beyond my expectations. I used the standard mode, but if you use the automatic mode, there's one more pre-wash, so if you have dishes that you're worried about being washed well, you can use the automatic mode. The standard mode was enough to have perfect cleaning power. Ample storage space My family is a two-person household, so we don't usually wash a lot of dishes at once, but we had guests over, so there were dishes for 8 people. I was worried that it wouldn't fit, but it had enough storage space. Thanks to this, you can wash large pots and frying pans in the dishwasher without any restrictions. Of course, it would be difficult to wash large pots like a rice cooker, but it's a size that can easily fit a kimchi stew pot and a side dish for 6 people. Automatic door opening system The biggest reason I chose this model. When the washing is finished, the door automatically opens and ventilation starts. When the technician explained it to me, he said that it was a function applied to the latest model. I know that many people suffer from mold or water stains due to steam and water accumulated inside the dishwasher when using it, but this model is much easier to maintain because it opens the door and ventilates at the end. Of course, the technician said that it is less dangerous to open the door wider and let it dry naturally. Please refer to this if you want to know! Friendly and convenient AS This is the part that surprised me the most this time! If it's not a big brand product, the thing I worry about the most is the repair problem when it breaks or something. I bought a truckload of appliances that broke and were thrown away because they were cheap. So I worried a lot, but surprisingly, I didn't have to worry. It only took a day for the technician to set up the first appointment and install it, and he was very kind. And it seemed like Coupang manages the entire service. He said that if there was a problem, I could report it right away and it would be resolved. As expected, the delivery, installation, and repair were all rockets! The technician was very kind. The installation only took about 30 minutes, so I was really satisfied. Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money. ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat one meal at home, dinner. But the dishes are so numerous and annoying that I desperately wanted a dishwasher. In Korea, dishwashers are all the rage, but Media was a brand I'd never heard of before, so I was a little worried. But it was a needless worry. This is my number one auntie item. The design fits my clean, modern interior perfectly. I love the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the installer first installed it, I thought it was too big, but it actually looks prettier. It's a kitchen interior that feels complete with just one child. I didn't want to build a cabinet, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink. It's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose. (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) Just attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it, and you're done! Installed in 30 minutes, very friendly technician. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from beginning to end, and he explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it is very useful. I use only the standard mode, and it washes very clean. The automatic door open function & app control are my favorite functions! The door opens automatically after washing. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work, and the door opens automatically when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying out or mold. It can also be controlled through the app, right? If you look at the app, there are more cleaning functions, so I plan to try them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? This is truly a great value for money item! I highly recommend this to those who find a large dishwasher too burdensome and want a dishwasher with good performance at a reasonable price. I didn't want to build a cabinet, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink. It's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose. (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) Just attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it, and you're done! Installed in 30 minutes, very friendly technician. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it is very useful. I use only the standard mode, and it washes very clean. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money. ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat one meal at home, dinner. But the dishes are so numerous and annoying that I desperately wanted a dishwasher. In Korea, dishwashers are all the rage, but Media was a brand I'd never heard of before, so I was a little worried. But it was a needless worry. This is my number one auntie item. The design fits my clean, modern interior perfectly. I love the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the installer first installed it, I thought it was too big, but it actually looks prettier. It's a kitchen interior that feels complete with just one child. I didn't want to build a cabinet, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink. It's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose. (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) Just attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it, and you're done! Installed in 30 minutes, very friendly technician. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from beginning to end, and he explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it is very useful. I use only the standard mode, and it washes very clean. The automatic door open function & app control are my favorite functions! The door opens automatically after washing. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work, and the door opens automatically when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying out or mold. It can also be controlled through the app, right? If you look at the app, there are more cleaning functions, so I plan to try them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? This is truly a great value for money item! I highly recommend this to those who find a large dishwasher too burdensome and want a dishwasher with good performance at a reasonable price. I didn't want to build a cabinet, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink. It's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose. (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) Just attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it, and you're done! Installed in 30 minutes, very friendly technician. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from beginning to end, and he explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. Comments (English): [ I finally own a dishwasher, the best value for money. ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. I'm a two-person household and only eat one meal at home, dinner. But it was a needless worry. This is my number one auntie item. The design fits my clean, modern interior perfectly. I love the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the installer first installed it, I thought it was too big, but it actually looks prettier. It's a kitchen interior that feels complete with just one child. I didn't want to build a cabinet, so I asked for it to be installed right next to the sink. It's super convenient because I can rinse it and move it right away. Please note that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose. (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) Just attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it, and you're done! Installed in 30 minutes, very friendly technician. On the morning of the installation, the technician called me to make an appointment and came and installed it in 30 minutes. The technician was very friendly from beginning to end, and he explained the operation method in detail, so I was very grateful. There was no need to worry about noise when drilling, it was very smooth. The interior is very spacious, and there are various modes. The interior is very spacious, so you can easily fit large pots and bowls, and the spoon holder is hung so you can safely store spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them one by one. In addition to the standard mode, there are various functions such as the rapid mode, strong mode, and timer function, so it is very useful. I use only the standard mode, and it washes very clean. The automatic door open function & app control are my favorite functions! The door opens automatically after washing. It takes about an hour, so I can turn it on when I go to work, and the door opens automatically when it's done, so I don't have to worry about drying out or mold. It can also be controlled through the app, right? If you look at the app, there are more cleaning functions, so I plan to try them all in the future. Long live the 21st century. Wow, I'm finally free from the pain of washing dishes. Even though I'm a two-person household and only eat one meal at home, the dishes are so numerous and annoying, I'm desperately craving a dishwasher. In Korea, dishwashers are often sold as either Sam-daeng or L-daeng. Media was a brand I'd never heard of before, so I was a little worried. But it was a needless worry. This is my number one auntie item. The design blends perfectly with my clean, modern interior. I absolutely love the soft cream color and the wood accents. When the installer first installed it, I thought it was too big. It actually looks even prettier because it's so big. It makes my kitchen look complete. I asked them to install it right next to the sink because I didn't want to have to worry about having to install it. It's super convenient because I can just rinse it and move it right away. Just be aware that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) All I had to do was attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it! The installation was a breeze, done in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly. I called the morning of the installation to schedule an appointment. He arrived and installed the unit in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly from start to finish, and he explained the operation thoroughly. I was so grateful. The drilling was smooth and noise-free. The interior is spacious, with a variety of modes. The interior is so roomy that even large pots and bowls can fit. The spoon holder is also hung, so you can safely store your spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them like Tetris. Besides the standard mode, there are also various functions, such as a quick mode, a powerful mode, and a timer, which are incredibly useful. I use the standard mode alone and it washes the unit squeakily clean. The automatic door opening function and app control are my favorite features! The door automatically opens after the wash cycle is complete. Even if it takes about an hour to finish, I can leave it running on my way to work. The door automatically opens after the wash cycle is complete, so I don't have to worry about drying out or mold. It also can be controlled via app, right? The app offers a wider range of cleaning functions, so I'm planning on trying them all out. Long live the 21st century. Conclusion: This level of performance at this price? This is truly a great value, a must-have item! All I had to do was attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it! The installation was a breeze, done in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly. I called the morning of the installation to schedule an appointment. He arrived and installed the unit in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly from start to finish, and he explained the operation thoroughly. I was so grateful. The drilling was smooth and noise-free. The interior is spacious, with a variety of modes. The interior is so roomy that even large pots and bowls can fit. The spoon holder is also hung, so you can safely store your spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them like Tetris. Besides the standard mode, there are also various functions, such as a quick mode, a powerful mode, and a timer, which are incredibly useful. I use the standard mode alone and it washes the unit squeakily clean. The automatic door opening function and app control are my favorite features! Just be aware that you'll need to drill a small hole in the countertop for the water hose! (If it's engineered stone or marble, there's an additional 100,000 won charge.) All I had to do was attach the drain hose to the sink and hide it! The installation was a breeze, done in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly. I called the morning of the installation to schedule an appointment. He arrived and installed the unit in 30 minutes. The installer was very friendly from start to finish, and he explained the operation thoroughly. I was so grateful. The drilling was smooth and noise-free. The interior is spacious, with a variety of modes. The interior is so roomy that even large pots and bowls can fit. The spoon holder is also hung, so you can safely store your spoons and chopsticks. It's also fun to stack them like Tetris. Besides the standard mode, there are also various functions, such as a quick mode, a powerful mode, and a timer, which are incredibly useful. I use the standard mode alone and it washes the unit squeakily clean. The automatic door opening function and app control are my favorite features! Sentence (English): Can I give this more than 5 stars?
Comments (English): [ 10/10 Beat my expectations! ] || ---------------- || Can I give this more than 5 stars? I was looking at more cost effective models and my Husband, who installs kitchens, said we should spend the extra on the Bosch. I reluctantly agreed. To start, we have been using an older model of dishwasher that came with our house, previously a rental, and have been using it for 6 years. The plastic strainer in the bottom has warped over time from the heating element and food particles were getting through and stuck in the water sprayers. It's a pain, dishes never get cleaned well despite using high end detergents and rinse aids. We would end up hand washing quite often for stuck on foods. Not to mention the dishes had to go in basically washed so it wouldn't clog up! It was time for a new one. We got the Bosch 800 and WOW! WOW! WOW! I have had the dishwasher for 2 months, family of 5, with daily use. I am blown away by the spot free finish the crystal dry gives. The customizeable power wash is life changing. I had dried on gummy whipped cream in a dessert dish and decided to test how much it could handle and I didn't scrub it out before loading it. It came perfectly spotless, squeaky clean! The app allows for more custom settings if you need them, but there's so many on the unit already, it's not necessary. I don't think we are going through rinse aid as quick and getting an unbelievable clean finish. I'm no longer worried about spots on my glasses when serving guests! I love the flex third row for silverware, serving utensils, measuring cups and more. This saves so much space vs putting them in the basket on the bottom. I also appreciate the adjustable top row basket. It really does get used more than I expected to help accommodate tall glasses and small pans. I REALLY appreciate how solid the bottom basket is and how it stays on the track! Another huge improvement is that there is no heating element- so plastic wear can get loaded anywhere! Hello, no more warped lids and containers when the kids put them on the bottom. I seriously didn't think a dishwasher could surpass all my expectations like this one has. I hope to eventually switch all of my appliances over to Bosch as we replace them. I am beyond pleased and it was worth every penny!

It's a pain, dishes never get cleaned well despite using high end detergents and rinse aids. We would end up hand washing quite often for stuck on foods. The app allows for more custom settings if you need them, but there's so many on the unit already, it's not necessary. I don't think we are going through rinse aid as quick and getting an unbelievable clean finish. I'm no longer worried about spots on my glasses when serving guests! I REALLY appreciate how solid the bottom basket is and how it stays on the track! Another huge improvement is that there is no heating element- so plastic wear can get loaded anywhere! Hello, no more warped lids and containers when the kids put them on the bottom. I seriously didn't think a dishwasher could surpass all my expectations like this one has. I hope to eventually switch all of my appliances over to Bosch as we replace them. I am beyond pleased and it was worth every penny!

Sentence (English): When my old dishwasher (24 years old) broke down, I started looking for a new one, and I opted for the Bosch brand on the recommendation of my daughter and my brother-in-law, since both have dishwashers of this brand and are delighted with it.
Comments (English): [ Happy with the purchase ] || ---------------- || When my old dishwasher (24 years old) broke down, I started looking for a new one, and I opted for the Bosch brand on the recommendation of my daughter and my brother-in-law, since both have dishwashers of this brand and are delighted with it. I saw this model and I didn't think about it much: the third tray, the spaciousness for its 14-place capacity, the simplicity of its use, the extended warranty on its tub, were aspects that made my decision easier. I have only used it once, and I have used the 1h 65° program (since I have the habit of "giving everything a wash" before putting it in the dishwasher), and that program does not have a pre-wash, and the result has been great. For now, very happy with the purchase
Comments (Original): [ Feliz con la compra ] || ---------------- || Al averiarse mi viejo lavavajillas (24 años)me puse a buscar uno nuevo, y me decante por la marca Bosch por recomendación de mi hija y mi cuñado, ya que ambos tienen lavavajillas de esta marca y están encantados.Vi este modelo y no me lo pensé mucho: la tercera bandeja, la amplitud para sus 14 servicios de capacidad, la sencillez en su manejo, la extensión en la garantía de su cuba....fueron aspectos que facilitaron mi decision. Solo le he usado una vez, y he usado el programa 1h 65° (ya que yo tengo por costumbre 'darle un agua' a todo antes de meterlo en el lavavajillas), y ese programa no tiene prelavado, y el resultado ha sido buenísimo.Por ahora, muy feliz con la compra

The interior layout of my old Bosch that this unit replaced worked better. I would still recommend this washing machine but you may want to consider what you are washing and look closely at the interior space before buying to make sure you are not disappointed.

Sentence (English): CONS: I bought this a few weeks ago and I think I'll be returning it.
Comments (English): [ Doesn't dry ] || ---------------- || CONS: I bought this a few weeks ago and I think I'll be returning it. It doesn't dry. I tried everything recommended, I added rinse aid, turn on high temp wash and sanitize settings and still utensils, mugs come out wet. I also don't like how flimsy the door is. You have to slam the door shut to have them close, if you just lightly push them close they will go right back down open. It's sad that instead of seeing improvement as time go by, we going back to stone ages because of some made up agenda. I have had Samsung dishwasher in the past in a prior house and it wasn't a most expensive one and it dried wonderfully, also my current one, 10 years old Whirlpool, which this was supposed to be a replacement for, dries wonderfully even without rinse aid.PROS: I do like the Wi-Fi connectivity and the fact that you can see how much time is left to finish washing. Also the dishwasher is fairly quiet.

Sentence (English): I live alone but I like to cook at home, so I always had a lot of concerns about dishwashers.
Comments (English): I live alone but I like to cook at home, so I always had a lot of concerns about dishwashers. There were many cases where I didn't like the design, the size was too small or big, or it was inconvenient to operate, but I chose the Media dishwasher because it seemed to meet all of my requirements. Here are my thoughts after using it for a few days. 1. The design is pretty. I'm a looker who buys cars based on design rather than performance, but the simple design and wooden handle details were pretty enough to capture my heart. The ivory color was also warm and not flashy, and it was a color that blended in well with the background of the house. 2. It's easy to use. It can be operated with one button without complicated settings. If you want more detailed settings and management, you can easily use the remote control app. 3. It has excellent performance. Even with just the rapid setting, all the oily and seasoned dishes were washed cleanly. Even without the strong setting, it removed most of the dirt. This was the best part. 4. Other advantages: The door automatically opens after washing to ventilate the room, which is great for managing water in dishes and contamination inside the dishwasher. The noise level is also lower than I expected, which is good. I will test it in more cases in the future, but this is a product that I am more excited about than worried about!

In the photo, I put a 20cm stainless steel frying pan in the middle, and it fits a lot of dishes. Anyway, a frying pan fits, too. The capacity is perfect for a 1-2 person household. I do a quick wash right after meals, removing any large items or sauces, and then use the high-speed feature. It takes about 30 minutes to clean up, and I'm so happy I don't have to worry about dishes piling up for the next meal. I work from home and tend to be a bit sloppy with my dishes, but I've done them all at once in the evening, and it used to take over 30 minutes. But the dishwasher cleans them all in the same amount of time, which is great! My kitchen is on the small side, but the design is nice and doesn't overwhelm the eyes, even when it takes up a little space. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone who works from home, especially those who find themselves with a lot of dishes to clean after every meal. Worrying only delays the freedom from washing dishes~! Detergent: I bought a Frosh, but it was for 12 people, so I cut it into quarters, but it broke too much when cutting it. I tried a detergent for 6 people, and this one is much easier. It's easier to cut it into 2 for 6 people. Are there people like me who are worried about refilling water and maintaining the water tank every time they use it because they don't want to bother with dishes? Assuming there are already holes, even women can use the dishwasher with just one button in an hour! Noise: The sound of water is like ASMR, like the sound of rain. It's not quiet, but it's not incredibly loud either. Our kitchen-living room is small, so when I turn it on, I turn up the TV volume a bit. It's not noticeable when I'm in my room.
