Sentence (English): When we moved into our new home, we purchased a dishwasher, which is considered a must-have these days.
Comments (English): [ Thanks to the dishwasher lady, my kitchen life has become so much easier! ] || ---------------- || When we moved into our new home, we purchased a dishwasher, which is considered a must-have these days. I was skeptical of the saying that "life is divided into two generations: one with a dishwasher and one without," but after using it, I found it to be true! I usually wash dishes immediately, so there isn't a huge pile, but it is incredibly convenient to be able to handle the many dishes generated during cooking all at once. When choosing a dishwasher, I considered the availability of after-sales service, the automatic door opening function, and the sterilization function. While cost-effectiveness is important, I prioritized after-sales service the most, so I chose the Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher. The clean white color matches our home's interior well, and I am satisfied every time I look at it. The installation process was also very satisfying! The technician contacted me a day in advance to provide guidance on the drilling and advice on using the detergent dispenser. They explained the possibility of water splashing when using the dispenser and kindly handled my request to purchase a rubber stopper and seal it with silicone. I asked them to check several times to ensure there were no leaks, and I was grateful that the technician answered kindly until the very end. Thanks to the detailed explanation of how to use it, my husband and I, even as first-time users, were able to learn it quickly. We received thorough guidance on everything from detergent selection to usage, which gave us greater peace of mind. However, it is a bit disappointing that they suddenly offered a huge discount on the day we received the item, making me feel like I paid too much for nothing. The noise isn't loud, but it did take some time to get used to at first. Now, it doesn't bother me at all. It was cute to see our cats staring intently at the dishwasher while it was in use. So far, we have mainly used the standard and powerful cycles, but we plan to try out other functions one by one. Thanks to this, the time spent on washing dishes has decreased, allowing us to enjoy a more relaxed kitchen life. I highly recommend this as an essential item that has made our kitchen life much easier!

Sentence (English): The dishwasher does a really good job of washing dishes.
Comments (English): [ Bosch SHP78CM5N dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher does a really good job of washing dishes. It appears to be equally effective on normal or 1-hour cycle. Learning to use it has been confusing. The stickers on the unit and the printed materials referred to controls that did not exist as named. There is no real owner's manual -- you have to go to a web site and get bits and peices of what you are after. And the web site compounded the problem of label identification. It would appear to really learn about the unit you have to download an app to your phone so the unit can communicate to the universe via a Bluetooth connection to your phone. So your learning is held hostage to yet another bloat-ware on your phone. I down loaded the app and followed the instructions for Bluetooth pairing. Did not work. I have successfully made many Bluetooth pairings but not this one. We used the dishwasher for over a month without making the connection. I called the help line and eventually we got past the mididentified control labels and I successfully paired dishwasher and phone. This reliance on my account and phone points out a problem -- how to have others uses features of the device. In order for other people to use the dishwasher, I have to give their email addresses to Bosch so that Bosch can send them invites to download the app, set up accounts, and go through the pairing process as well. Overall, the dishwasher does a really good job but you have to put in a wwhhoollee lot of effort to figure out how to use it.
